                                                  Shenzhen Investment Limited
                 has been listed on the Main Board of The Stock Exchange of Hong Kong Limited since 1997, is the largest listed real
                  estate company under State-owned Assets Supervision and Administration Commission of Shenzhen Municipal. The
                  Company’s core business includes property development (including residential real estate, industrial real estate and
                            commercial complex), property investment and management. By intensifying its development in
                    Shenzhen, focusing on the Greater Bay Area and planning for its development in other core cities in China, the
                                Company is committed to be a first-class real estate developer and real estate operator.

                 The Group currently has a land reserve with a planned total gross floor area close to 6.28 million square meters in
                 various cities of China, of which the quality land reserve with a planned total gross floor area of approximately 2.47
                  million square meters is located in Shenzhen. The Company is committed to optimizing its land reserves structure,
                      and concentrate its assets and business in the Greater Bay Area as well as key first- and second-tier cities.

                   It has all along been the Company’s core strategic goal to promote the long term sustainable development of its
                           business, with an aim to bring a stable return and create value appreciation for its shareholders.

                                                                                                                Corporate Profile
                                                                                                                      公司簡介


                                          深圳控股有限公司
於1997年在香港聯合交易所有限公司主板上市，是深圳市國資委旗下最大的房地產上市公司。公司核心業務
 包括物業開發（包括住宅地產，產業地產及商業綜合體）、物業投資及管理。公司深耕深圳，聚焦大灣區，
          佈局其他中國核心城市，致力於成為一流的房地產開發及不動產運營商。

目前本集團於國內多個城市合共擁有規劃總建築面積近628萬平方米的土地儲備，其中位於深圳的優質土地儲
         備的規劃總建築面積約247萬平方米。公司致力優化土地儲備的結構，
              將資產和業務向大灣區和重點一二線城市集中。

 公司一貫之核心策略目標，乃致力推動業務長期持續發展，以期為股東帶來整體穩定回報及締造價值增長。

In 2018, China’s economy has further shifted away from high-speed growth to
high-quality development. The global macro-environment was complicated and
changing with rising downward pressure, tightened overall liquidity and wider           二零一八年，中國經濟進一步從高速增長向高質量發
fluctuations in the capital market, which brings various challenges to business         展 轉 型。 全 球 宏 觀 環 境 複 雜 多 變， 經 濟 下 行 壓 力 加
operation. “House is a place to live instead of a tool for speculation” has been        大，整體流動性偏緊，資本市場出現較大波動，企業
a keynote for the Chinese real estate development and the effect of industry            經營發展面臨多重挑戰。「房住不炒」已是中國房地產
regulation has gradually appeared. Impacted by the new real estate control policy       市場發展的基調，行業調控影響逐漸顯現，受到7月底
issued at the end of July and the fluctuations in capital market, the real estate       出台房地產調控新政以及資本市場波動的影響，深圳
market of Shenzhen became depressed in the second half of the year. As a result,        房地產市場在下半年逐漸轉入低迷，全年成交量與去
annual trading volume was flat with the previous year and, due to the policy of         年持平，成交價格在限價政策下保持穩定。三四線城
price restriction, trading price maintained stable. There were also changes in the      市房地產市場下半年也出現了變化，部分城市價量有
real estate market in the third-tier and fourth-tier cities in the second half of the   所回調。
year and some cities saw recovery in both price and volume.

Under the mixed external environment, the Group was able to overcome various            面對複雜的外部環境，本集團克服諸多不利因素，業
difficulties and maintain a stable results performance by grasping market               績保持穩定。一方面，把握市場時機，拓展優質土地
opportunity to expand quality land resource and strengthening finance and               資源，加強融資及財務保障；另一方面，啟動若干運
financial support on the one hand, while on the other hand launching the mixed-         營平台的混合所有制改革，在發展轉型上邁出堅實一
ownership reform on certain of its operating platforms, a solid step to its growth      步，為本集團中長期發展奠定良好基礎。
transformation, so as to lay a sound foundation for its medium and long term
development.

The Company is committed to maintaining high standard of corporate governance.      本公司致力恪守奉行高標準之企業管治。本公司董事

corporate governance is essential for effective management, a healthy corporate     全之企業文化、成功之業務發展，以及提升股東價值
culture, successful business growth and enhancing shareholders’ value. The          至關重要。本公司已於整個二零一八年應用並遵守香
Company has applied the principles and complied with all code provisions of the     港聯合交易所有限公司證券上市規則（「上市規則」）附
Corporate Governance Code (“CG Code”) as set out in Appendix 14 to the Rules        錄十四所載之企業管治守則（「企業管治守則」）之所有
Governing the Listing of Securities on The Stock Exchange of Hong Kong Limited      原則及守則條文。
(“Listing Rules”) throughout the year 2018.

Risk Management and Internal Control                                                風險管理與內部監控
Responsibility                                                                      責任
The Board is responsible for the risk management and internal control systems       董事會須對風險管理及內部監控系統負責，有責任檢
and reviewing the effectiveness of such systems. Management is responsible for      討該等制度的有效性，而管理層則負責設計及執行內
designing and implementing an internal control system to manage the risks to the    部監控制度以最大限度的管理公司面臨的風險，達到
Company to the maximum extent, in order to identify and manage these risks so       識別和管理這些風險，從而可以掌握、降低、舒緩、
as to understand, reduce, mitigate, divert or avoid these risks. The Board hereby   轉移或規避這些風險。董事會謹在此闡釋該等系統旨
explains that the systems are designed to manage, rather than eliminate, the risk   在管理而非消除未能達成業務目標的風險，而且只能
of failure to meet business objectives, and only to provide reasonable, but not     就不會有重大的失實陳述或損失作出合理而非絕對的
absolute, assurance against material misstatement or loss.                          保證。

Risk Management Process                                                                 風險管理程序
The Company adopts an integrated “bottom-up” and “top-down” risk review                 公司採用「由下而上」的方式配合「由上而下」的綜合
process, requiring the heads of functional departments and business units of the        風險檢討程序，要求公司職能部門及業務部門主管參
Company to participate in identifying operational risks and incorporate them into       與識別營運風險，納入各項業務及決策流程中，包括
various business and decision-making processes, including strategy formulation,         策略制定、業務發展、業務規劃、資金分配、投資決
business development, business planning, capital allocation, investment decisions,      定、內部監控及日常營運等，以便於
internal controls and daily operations, to enable

(1)   comprehensive identification and prioritization of all significant risks within   (1)       全面識別集團內部所有的重大風險，並進行優次
      the Group;                                                                                  排序，

(2)   reporting of significant risks to the appropriate management level;               (2)       將重大風險上報至適當的管理層級別，

(3)   the management to effectively communicate about the risks.                        (3)       讓管理層就風險進行有效溝通。

                         an asset with an alternative use to the entity and                                            其本身並不具有其他替代
                         the entity has an enforceable right to payment for                                            用途的資產，及實體有權
                         performance completed to date.                                                                就迄今所完成的履約獲得
                                                                                                                       付款。

             Financial guarantees are contracts that require the issuer (i.e.                             財務擔保為要求發行人（即擔保人）
             the guarantor) to make specified payments to reimburse the                                   就擔保受益人（「持有人」）因指定債

               Financial guarantees issued are initially recognised within                                 已發出財務擔保初步於「其他應付款
               “Other payables and accruals” at fair value, which is determined                            項及應計費用」中按公允值確認，而
               by reference to fees charged in an arm’s length transaction                                 該公允值乃參照類似服務於公平磋商
               for similar services, when such information is obtainable, or                               交易之過程中所收取費用（如可獲得
               to interest rate differentials, by comparing the actual rates                               該等資料）而釐定，或參照息差作出
               charged by lenders when the guarantee is made available with                                估計，方法為以放款人在獲提供擔保
               the estimated rates that lenders would have charged, had the                                之情況下實際收取之利率與在不獲提
               guarantees not been available, where reliable estimates of such                             供擔保之情況下放款人將會收取之估
               information can be made. Where consideration is received or                                 計利率作比較（如該等資料能可靠地
               receivable for the issuance of the guarantee, the consideration                             估計）。倘就作出擔保之代價已收取
               is recognised in accordance with the Group’s policies applicable                            或可收取，代價則根據本集團適用於
               to that category of asset. Where no such consideration is                                   此類別資產之政策確認。倘並無收到
               received or receivable, an immediate expense is recognised in                               或無可收代價，則在損益確認為即時
               profit or loss.                                                                             開支。

               Subsequent to initial recognition, the amount initially recognised                          於初步確認後，初步確認為遞延收入
